metadata.title: Graphic user interfaces to process single-channel patch clamp recordings
metadata.description:
This archive contains raw experimental data and corresponding MATLAB analysis source code in the form of modules (applications with graphic user interfaces) regarding our article entitled "A detailed analysis of single-channel Nav1.5 recordings does not reveal any cooperative gating" that was published in 2023 in The Journal of Physiology (vol 601, pp. 3847-3868, https://dx.doi.org/10.1113/JP284861).
First, download the file "Documentation.pdf" and follow the instructions/descriptions provided in this file.

We are greatly indebted to Benjamin Haeffele, Billy Kang and Manu Ben-Johny for sharing their MATLAB code to de-trend recordings.
